title: Cart Abandonment Recovery, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Cart Abandonment Recovery agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Cart Abandonment Recovery Abandoned Carts list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Synthetic returning-shopper cart (AbandonedCartId CART-20001), with Contactable Yes.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Cart Abandonment Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 4 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Marketing Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Marketing Manager, show where the anonymous synthetic cart journey is breaking down and what needs review.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Marketing Manager; Synthetic Cart Abandonment Analysis; no shopper is contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Digital Marketing Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Digital Marketing Lead, outline a consent-aware draft sequence without sending or scheduling anything.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Digital Marketing Lead; Draft Recovery Campaign Dashboard; not deployed. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Growth Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Growth Manager, compare margin-aware value scenarios and keep every concept behind approval.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Growth Manager; Draft Incentive Scenario Comparison; Scenario for approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Growth Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Growth Manager, summarize the fixed recovery metrics and separate benchmarks from planning estimates.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Synthetic Conversion Tracking; Recovery Rate; no cart or purchase is changed. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Cart Abandonment Recovery: 4 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including Synthetic returning-shopper cart (AbandonedCartId CART-20001), with Contactable Yes.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Cart Abandonment Recovery Abandoned Carts from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload abandoned-carts.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AbandonedCartId, Contactable, Segment, Items, AbandonedAt, PageExit, Device, RecoveryStatus to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CartValue, PriorPurchases as Number. Name the list Cart Abandonment Recovery Abandoned Carts. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Synthetic returning-shopper cart (AbandonedCartId CART-20001), with Contactable Yes.

steps.title: Create Cart Abandonment Recovery Recovery Campaigns from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload recovery-campaigns.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RecoveryCampaignId, Subject, Incentive to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep DelayHours, AvgOpenRate, AvgConversion as Number. Name the list Cart Abandonment Recovery Recovery Campaigns. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Draft Email Reminder (RecoveryCampaignId email_1), with DelayHours 1.

steps.title: Create Cart Abandonment Recovery Incentive Options from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload incentive-options.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set IncentiveOptionId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CostMarginImpact, ConversionLift as Number. Name the list Cart Abandonment Recovery Incentive Options. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including 10% off cart total (IncentiveOptionId percent_off_10), with CostMarginImpact 10.0.

steps.title: Create Cart Abandonment Recovery Conversion Metrics from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload conversion-metrics.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ConversionMetricId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Value as Number. Name the list Cart Abandonment Recovery Conversion Metrics. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including overall_abandonment_rate (ConversionMetricId overall_abandonment_rate), with Value 71.4.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Cart Abandonment Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Cart Abandonment Recovery Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the four list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_cart-recovery-rules-and-safety.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the abandoned carts tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Cart Abandonment Recovery Abandoned Carts; name the tool Get abandoned cart records.
steps.expected: Get abandoned cart records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the recovery campaigns tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Cart Abandonment Recovery Recovery Campaigns; name the tool Get recovery campaign records.
steps.expected: Get recovery campaign records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the incentive options tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Cart Abandonment Recovery Incentive Options; name the tool Get incentive option records.
steps.expected: Get incentive option records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the conversion metrics tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Cart Abandonment Recovery Conversion Metrics; name the tool Get conversion metric records.
steps.expected: Get conversion metric records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 4 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 4 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Marketing Manager; Synthetic Cart Abandonment Analysis; no shopper is contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Digital Marketing Lead; Draft Recovery Campaign Dashboard; not deployed. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.prompt: As Growth Manager, compare margin-aware value scenarios and keep every concept behind approval.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Growth Manager; Draft Incentive Scenario Comparison; Scenario for approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Growth Manager, summarize the fixed recovery metrics and separate benchmarks from planning estimates.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Synthetic Conversion Tracking; Recovery Rate; no cart or purchase is changed. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: cart-abandonment-recovery-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 4 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Cart Abandonment Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Cart Abandonment Recovery Abandoned Carts" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Cart Abandonment Recovery Recovery Campaigns" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Cart Abandonment Recovery Incentive Options" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Cart Abandonment Recovery Conversion Metrics" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Cart Abandonment Recovery Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Cart Abandonment Recovery Abandoned Carts tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including Synthetic returning-shopper cart (AbandonedCartId CART-20001), with Contactable Yes.
